detail.heading: Taj Mahal
detail.text:
HeritageVerse

BACK TO EXPLORE

MAUSOLEUM AND TOMB

Taj Mahal

Agra, Uttar Pradesh

A white marble mausoleum set within a formal garden complex on the Yamuna.
[1]

Save favorite
Mark visited

Save this place or mark it as visited to find it again later.

Gallery

The Taj Mahal, seen from the riverbed · 1855–1865

Francis Frith; image courtesy of The J. Paul Getty Museum, Los Angeles (CC0 1.0 via Wikimedia Commons)

Image source
CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication

Taj Mahal in 2025 · 2025-10-04

Dudva (CC0 1.0 via Wikimedia Commons)

Image source
CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication

Overview

A white marble mausoleum set within a formal garden complex on the Yamuna.
[1]

History

Commissioned by Mughal emperor Shah Jahan; construction of the mausoleum ran from 1632 to 1648, with associated works completed later.
[1]

Cultural significance

It is recognized as a major work of Indo-Islamic sepulchral architecture and craftsmanship.
[1]

Architecture

Symmetrical marble mausoleum, dome, minarets, mosque, guest house and garden; inlaid stone decoration.
[1]

Timeline

1983 CE

Inscribed on UNESCO World Heritage List

The property was inscribed on UNESCO’s W
